title: Jack in the Box Brings The Simpsons Treehouse of Horror to the Drive-Thru with a Monstrous Menu for a Limited Time
summary: SAN DIEGO, September 10, 2026--Halloween in Springfield is taking over Jack in the Box. Jack in the Box (NASDAQ: JACK) is teaming up with The Simpsons to bring the iconic Treehouse of Horror specials from the screen to the drive-thru with a limited-time lineup featuring Krusty-inspired burgers, Forbidden D’oh!nut Holes, an all-new Spooky Simpsons Sauce, six special-edition glow-in-the-dark cups and custom packaging that brings Jack Box into the twisted world of Treehouse of Horror.

title: Del Taco Celebrates #1 Fast Food Honors With Free Tacos in Port St. Lucie
summary: PORT ST. LUCIE, Fla., Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Del Taco, the nation’s second-largest Mexican quick service restaurant*, is celebrating its recent recognition as the #1 Best Fast Food Restaurant in USA TODAY's 2026 10Best Reader's Choice Awards with a four-day celebration at its Port St. Lucie restaurant. From Sept. 10 through Sept. 13, the first 50 customers each day who make any purchase will receive two free The Del Tacos and a free Del Taco T-shirt, totaling 100 free tacos per day!
